paite: Siampu Levite, Levi nam tengteng in Israelte lak ah tantuan leh goutan anei ding uh ahi kei. TOUPA kiang a mei a thillat leh amau a tuam pen ane ding uhi.
heading: Siampute Tan
english: The priests and the Levites—all the tribe of Levi—shall have no portion nor inheritance with Israel. They shall eat the offerings of Yahweh made by fire and his portion.

paite: A unaute uh lak ah goutan anei ding uh ahi kei; agoutan uh bel akiang ua agen bang in TOUPA ahi ngal a.
english: They shall have no inheritance among their brothers. Yahweh is their inheritance, as he has spoken to them.

paite: Mipite lak a pan kithoihna lanpa siampu a tuam ding hiaite ahi: Bawngtal leh belam liang leh abiangtuai langnih leh agilpi siampu apiak ding uh ahi.
english: This shall be the priests’ due from the people, from those who offer a sacrifice, whether it be ox or sheep, that they shall give to the priest: the shoulder, the two cheeks, and the inner parts.

paite: Na buh na bal, na uain, na thau tung masate uh, na belam mulmet masakpente uh leng na piak ding uh ahi.
english: You shall give him the first fruits of your grain, of your new wine, and of your oil, and the first of the fleece of your sheep.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un TOUPA min a nasem a om tawntung ding in nam tengteng a pan amau leh atapate uh toh atel ahi ngal ua.
english: For Yahweh your God has chosen him out of all your tribes to stand to minister in Yahweh’s name, him and his sons forever.

paite: Levi mi kuapeuh atenna Israel gam na tenna ua akoipeuh pawtsan a, alungsim a kilawptak a TOUPA'N aseh ding mun a ahong paileh;
english: If a Levite comes from any of your gates out of all Israel where he lives, and comes with all the desire of his soul to the place which Yahweh shall choose,

paite: huai a TOUPA ma a om Levite, a-unaute mah bang in TOUPA a Pathian min in nna asem ding ahi.
english: then he shall minister in the name of Yahweh his God, as all his brothers the Levites do, who stand there before Yahweh.

paite: Asiamput man uh sim louh in midang tuam nek ding atang sam himhim ding uhi.
english: They shall have like portions to eat, in addition to that which comes from the sale of his family possessions.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un ahon piak ding gamsung a na lut chiang un, huai gam a namte thilhih kihhuaite zui kei un.
heading: Ginglou mite Thilhih Thu A Vauna
english: When you have come into the land which Yahweh your God gives you, you shall not learn to imitate the abominations of those nations.

paite: Na lak uah mi kuamah atapa hiam, atanu hiam mei a paisuaksak, mi kuamah aisan ching, mi kuamah mangsan ching hiam, bum hiam, mitkhialdawi tawi hiam,
english: There shall not be found with you anyone who makes his son or his daughter to pass through the fire, one who uses divination, one who tells fortunes, or an enchanter, or a sorcerer,

paite: zawl aitawi hiam, mi sisa houpih hiam, khate zawl hiam, misisate dong thei hiam na om ding uh ahi kei.
english: or a charmer, or someone who consults with a familiar spirit, or a wizard, or a necromancer.

paite: Hichibang thilhih chingte peuhmah TOUPA a ding in mikihhuai ahi ngal ua. Hiai thilkihhuaite ziak in ahi, TOUPA na Pathian un amaute ahon delhkhiaksak.
english: For whoever does these things is an abomination to Yahweh. Because of these abominations, Yahweh your God drives them out from before you.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian uh ma a na hoihkim ding uh ahi.
english: You shall be blameless with Yahweh your God.

paite: Huai na va luah ding uh gam a namte'n mitkhialdawi leh aisan ching mite angaikhia ua; nou zaw TOUPA na Pathian un huchibang hih ahon phal kei hi.
heading: Zawlnei Sawl Ding A Thuchiam
english: For these nations that you shall dispossess listen to those who practice sorcery and to diviners; but as for you, Yahweh your God has not allowed you so to do.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un keimah bang na unaute uh lak a mi zawlnei a hon bawlsak dia, ama thu na ngaikhe ding uh ahi.
english: Yahweh your God will raise up to you a prophet from among you, of your brothers, like me. You shall listen to him.

paite: "TOUPA i Pathian aw zaw hon zasak nawn ke'nla, hiai mei thupi hon musak nawn ke'n, ka si kha ding uh," chi a Horeb tang a kikhopkhawm ni a TOUPA na Pathian uh na deihdan bang un.
english: This is according to all that you desired of Yahweh your God in Horeb in the day of the assembly, saying, “Let me not hear again Yahweh my God’s voice, neither let me see this great fire any more, that I not die.”

paite: TOUPA'N ka kiang ah, athugen uh agen hoih ngel uhi.
english: Yahweh said to me, “They have well said that which they have spoken.

paite: A-unaute uh lak ah nangmah bang zawlnei ka bawlsak dia, akam ah ka thute ka koih dia, akiang a ka thupiak peuhmah akiang uah agen ding.
english: I will raise them up a prophet from among their brothers, like you. I will put my words in his mouth, and he shall speak to them all that I shall command him.

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, ka min a ka thu agen zui lou peuhmah ka ngaihtuah ding hi.
english: It shall happen, that whoever will not listen to my words which he shall speak in my name, I will require it of him.

paite: Ka min agen ding ka piak louh gen teitei zawlnei hiam, pathian dangte min a thugenmi zawlnei hiam, huai zawlnei hihlup ding ahi.
english: But the prophet who speaks a word presumptuously in my name, which I have not commanded him to speak, or who speaks in the name of other gods, that same prophet shall die.”

paite: "Na lungtang ua, bangchi in ahia athu TOUPA gen ahi kei chih i theih ding? na chih uleh,
english: You may say in your heart, “How shall we know the word which Yahweh has not spoken?”

paite: zawlnei in TOUPA min a thu agen a, athil gen pen ahong tangtun kei a, alohchin keileh, huaitak ahi, TOUPA gen louh, zawlnei in ki-uangsaktak in agen mawkmawk ahi a, amah na lau ding uh ahi kei," achi hi.
english: When a prophet speaks in Yahweh’s name, if the thing doesn’t follow, nor happen, that is the thing which Yahweh has not spoken. The prophet has spoken it presumptuously. You shall not be afraid of him.
